shared_elements: human head with schematic facial features (eyes, nose)
incised cross-hatching / grid hatching used to render hair or garment
arm/hand rendered as simple tapering form
justification: Both depict schematic human figures with simplified, blocky facial features and use fine incised cross-hatching to indicate hair or clothing, which is a mildly specific shared convention. However, A is a single figure in the round seen as a large head with a raised limb, while B is a flat multi-figure scene laid out in two registers of standing, facing figures with signs above, so the subject matter, relationships and arrangement scarcely correspond.
